topics.topic: Whether INV-18 blocks conflict-copy placement replay when a placement already exists
questions: Does this failure apply only when the content has no existing placement, or also when A3 rule 2 requires that placement to replay?
Does placing the hash of a conflict copy fail only when no placement already exists, while an existing placement replays, or must every such request fail?

quotes:
A name is judged when the folder is observed. R0-14 concerns files, not content: a conflict copy is
never a source of a new placement, an ordinary file with the same content as a conflict copy is placed
as usual, and content that already has a placement replays under A3 rule 2 whatever name it has now.

2. Placing an existing placement answers `replayed` with the stored placement and the current
   `photo_id` of its mark, if any, and writes nothing, even when the source file has left the
   folder.
judgement.why: The texts explicitly distinguish a new placement, which a conflict copy cannot source, from an existing placement, which replays even when only the conflict copy remains.

topics.topic: How placement handles file identity replacement after observation
questions: If another regular file appears at the observed path before the read, must placement reject the identity change as `unreadable_file`, or read that file and report `source_changed` when its bytes have another hash?

quotes:
A file renamed after the observation is no longer at the observed path, so reading it for placing fails
with `unreadable_file` (A3 rule 4).

3. Inside the call the folder is scanned once. A requested source with no placement that this scan
   does not report as `ready` fails with `not_ready_or_absent`. A source reported `ready` whose
   bytes no longer have the requested hash when it is read for placing fails with `source_changed`.
judgement.why: Whether reading after observation follows the observed file identity or reopens its path is operation-flow behavior for State 4, not a State 3 module-ownership question.
